BootUI 2.6.0 host-bound credentials (DefaultGitHubTokenProvider, 7287e6f92) ported; the token variables are stripped from gh's environment case-insensitively because Windows reads gh_token as GH_TOKEN; the variables sharpit sets for gh (GH_HOST, GH_PROMPT_DISABLED, GH_NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER) replace any inherited name of either case

beyond BootUI: a credential host that is not a plain lower-case host name ([a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*) resolves no credential and never reaches gh's argv: a Windows gh.cmd shim found through PATHEXT runs its arguments through cmd.exe parsing, and an argument starting with - would read as a gh option
beyond BootUI: gh is resolved to an absolute path from absolute PATH entries outside the working directory (BootUI runs whichever gh is first on PATH)
